text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak to deliver within days a message to the world about a new development project in south Egypt, heralding the start of a new civilization. Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri and 17 ministers go to the Toshka area in an inspection visit.
- The state-owned National Investment Bank to repay 1,450 million pounds in arrears payable by government agencies to contracting firms.

- Mubarak to announce withing days the start work on a giant national project to develop a new delta in south Egypt. Information Minister Safwat el-Sherif says the government received international applications to set up projects and companies.
- Sudanese opposition leaders Sadeq al-Mahdi and Mohammed Osman al-Mirghani met in Cairo to discuss the opposition action strategy.
- Former U.N. secretary general Boutros Boutros-Ghali left New York on his way back home. Boutros-Ghali will stop over in Paris.
- Police shot dead two terrorist leaders in the southern province of Minya after they opened fire on a police ambush.
